donorTests.skip: POSIX permissions do not apply on Windows

reaDecision: Not necessary for this bounded stdlib module: all source is available and direct source inspection plus actual tests answer the integration questions.
limitations: File fsync precedes publication; Node directory fsync is unsupported on Windows, so no power-loss guarantee is claimed there.
HTTP media import remains buffered with a 50 MiB cap; the adopted byte store itself accepts bounded async streams.
Render and HTTP serving still use verified file paths in the trusted-account model; same-account mutation after verification is not prevented.
Hash receipts detect corruption; they do not authenticate against an operator who can rewrite both data and receipts.
Job durability, portable archives and crash-lock recovery remain separate P02 tasks.
Damaged heads are fingerprinted in 64 KiB chunks with a 10-second read budget and preserved by a verified hardlink; JSON parsing retains its 2 MiB limit.
